sources.title: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport
sources.officialityEvidence: Immigration Department publishes this live official open-data CSV specifically for HKSAR Passport holders, with country-level notes and remarks.
sources.supportingExcerpt: HKSAR passport holders can apply for a visa upon arrival.

policies.title: HKSAR passport: Angola short-visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: Hong Kong Immigration's current HKSAR-passport dataset expressly says that holders may visit Angola visa-free for up to 30 days per entry.
conditions: Full HKSAR passport holder; up to 30 days per entry and 90 days per year, as stated in the current dataset.
BN(O), HKSAR Document of Identity, Mainland Chinese, Macao SAR, diplomatic, official and other travel documents are outside this policy.

policies.title: HKSAR passport: Bolivia short-visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Hong Kong Immigration's current HKSAR-passport dataset expressly says that holders can apply for a Bolivian tourist visa on arrival.
conditions: Full HKSAR passport holder; tourist visa on arrival for a stated stay of up to 30 days, subject to the destination's documentary and fee requirements.
BN(O), HKSAR Document of Identity, Mainland Chinese, Macao SAR, diplomatic, official and other travel documents are outside this policy.

policies.title: HKSAR passport: Comoros short-visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Hong Kong Immigration's current HKSAR-passport dataset expressly states that holders can apply for a visa upon arrival in Comoros.
conditions: Full HKSAR passport holder; the dataset records a stay of up to 45 days and says to consult the relevant embassy or consulate before travel.
BN(O), HKSAR Document of Identity, Mainland Chinese, Macao SAR, diplomatic, official and other travel documents are outside this policy.

conflicts.explanation: The current HKSAR-passport dataset expressly reports visa-free access to Angola, but no current Angolan source separately maps the HKSAR document; the issuance-timing correction is held.

The current HKSAR-passport dataset expressly says a tourist visa may be applied for on arrival in Bolivia, but no current Bolivian authority maps that document's issuance timing; the correction is held.
